listing.name: ThirstSector
listing.summary: Replaces all generic and named character portraits in the base game with machine-generated and manually edited images.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces all generic and named character portraits in the base game with machine-generated and manually edited images.

description:
Overview

ThirstSector is a complete portrait replacer for all generic and named characters in the base game. ThirstSector is available as a SFW mod with an optional NSFW expansion. All images were generated by machine learning and then edited manually.

Checkpoints

SpoilerMost images are generated with Darelite's Fantasy Mix checkpoint, and occasionally PerfectWorld v3 or v4, and occasionally PerfectDeliberate.[close]

Download
